title: Create Qt Quick application bootstrap
description:
Create the Qt Quick application entry point, AppController QObject, and root QML window that prove the CMake/Qt dependency contract works end-to-end.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- CMakeLists.txt — understand the existing target declaration and linked libraries from task a.1.
- cmake/Dependencies.cmake — confirm Qt6 components available.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Requirements:
1. src/app/main.cpp must create a QGuiApplication, instantiate AppController, register it as a QML context property or singleton, load qml/Main.qml via QQmlApplicationEngine, and enter the event loop.
2. src/app/AppController.hpp/cpp must declare a QObject subclass with Q_OBJECT macro. Expose a read-only `appName` Q_PROPERTY returning "Abracapture" and a read-only `appVersion` Q_PROPERTY returning "0.1.0".
3. qml/Main.qml must declare an ApplicationWindow with title bound to appController.appName, minimum size 800x600, and a centered Text element displaying the app name and version.
4. Update CMakeLists.txt to add the new .cpp/.hpp sources to the abracapture target and configure qt_add_qml_module or qt_add_resources for the QML files.
5. Do not add settings, audio, or capture logic — this is strictly the application shell.
acceptance_criteria: src/app/main.cpp exists and creates QGuiApplication and QQmlApplicationEngine
src/app/AppController.hpp declares a QObject subclass with Q_OBJECT and appName/appVersion Q_PROPERTYs
src/app/AppController.cpp implements AppController with appName returning Abracapture
qml/Main.qml declares an ApplicationWindow with title bound to appController.appName
CMakeLists.txt includes AppController.cpp, AppController.hpp, and main.cpp in the abracapture target sources
CMakeLists.txt configures QML resource handling for qml/Main.qml
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: add new dependencies or find_package calls
implement settings persistence or audio capture logic

allowed: choose between qt_add_qml_module and qt_add_resources for QML
choose QML context property vs singleton registration for AppController
